title: UI
summary: Design of the engine UI layer: panels split into view, collector and presenter, interned tones instead of colours, game facets, modal stack, controls registry, phases A-H.
notes: No frontmatter and no path convention; docs/design/ is described by the repo as 'how one subsystem works, and why'. Signals mixed: SPEC (Rust data models for Row, Facet, NearbyView, Tones, Palette, Modals; module placement per crate; test contracts; cost constraints), ADR (Status line 'phases A to G built 2026-09-12; H proposed', explicit numbered decisions in sections 0 and 5, trade-off analysis of backends, section 11b recording decisions changed during build), DOC (prose rationale). Multi-decision design doc rather than a single-decision ADR, so classified SPEC. Decisions in phases A-G are implemented and enforced by the project CLAUDE.md review rules; synthesizer should treat sections 0, 5 and 11b as settled, with 11b superseding earlier sections (Name not Label, views tier 2, collectors every frame, unset tone reported at startup, ChromeLayout removed with no replacement). Phase H (node presenters) is proposed only. Section 2's PresentSet::Narrate placement may be stale versus CLAUDE.md's ViewSet::Collect/ViewSet::Annotate. Output filename omits the SHA-256 path hash because no hashing tool was available; the slug includes the parent dirs to avoid collisions, matching sibling fields-docs-design.json.
